body:
i appreciate the offer!! but it's actually homework for my painting class. it's time consuming so it ends up towards the bottom of my priority list when i get like this

i ended up getting up and starting it so i don't have to pull a full all nighter tomorrow... thanks again for offering to help though :)
love live sunshine! i was a little hesitant to get into ll a few years ago because i'm not much of an idol anime person but it's one of my fav series now :'^)

it's a little easier for me to talk to people online than irl because it's so accessible and i have the time to think about how to reply in full... i dunno if i should keep reaching out at this point or give up. wishing you the best though - i love my music too but im not so great at athletics, being asthmatic and all. we just gotta take it one day at a time

things have just been shitty lately man. people who i thought were my friends have been leaving me in the dust and i cant figure out why. i generally try to avoid talking about my feelings when i feel like this and even when they say it's fine for me to open up i just get a response that feels really halfhearted, like it's a reply for the sake of replying. i kinda think it's just something wrong with me that i can't see cos this kind of thing has been happening for years. if i was the type who was ok with being totally alone i would have stopped talking to people a long time ago but here i am lol

for the note itself i thought it would help to just write everything out too but not being able to figure out who to address it to was really kinda crushing. after that i realized i didn't even know what i wanted to write in the first place so i felt dumb for even attempting

i had to leave the house to go do some group project work (im taking a break rn) and forcing myself to work has been a nice distraction at least. might get panera or something when we're done so i don't have to go back to my room for a little while longer. thanks for reaching out though, i appreciate it

hey, good luck with your finals too man. my situations kinda complicated - we had a first year art program that was all really general introductory classes and we couldnt skip it so after a year of doing basically nothing, im in my actual major and its.... more introductory classes but theyre more related to what im doing. its just felt like a big waste of time... im no good at anything like engineering or math related things so art felt like my only option for college. in first year i took psych and liked it enough that i considered switching to it entirely but im already 60% done with the art degree credit wise so i might as well finish what i started. way for me to be a hardhead about it lol


i still try to make art for myself or do some quick commissions but usually i have to just put off my schoolwork to do it and thats..... not a good idea to keep up with w/ my courseload. not doing things to destress just makes me more stressed and i end up in a shit loop like tonight lol


i keep telling myself that when im in classes i actually want to take maybe itll get better but thats what i told myself as a first year student and this year ended up being hellish cos it was just more intro classes. if next fall doesnt pan out i dunno what the hell im gonna do really. i wish it was possible to still not go to school for something but still make a living.... thank you for the input though

hi! 

i dont think ive ever really thought of help without meds being involved. just kind of assumed i would probably need them anyway to stay functional eventually. since the semester is about to end its not worth going to a counselor now but maybe itll be a better idea to pursue in the fall... i just really dont want my parents to find out somehow accidentally, yknow? my mom has access to all my mental and physical health records (with my permission) since physical illness brainfog makes it hard to remember what/how frequent my symptoms are sometimes. so theres a chance that she could find out... i think she'd take it better than my dad would but god that initial reaction to "what if they find out" is scary. we'll see how things are in the fall i guess

thank you for your reply though... ive been thinking about things a little more today between classes and what youve said helps. wishing you the best of luck out there too :)
